annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部 工业和信息化部 国家能源局关于印发《内河新能源船舶推广应用行动方案（2026—2030年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and National Energy Administration on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Application of New-Energy Inland Waterway Vessels (2026–2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology; National Energy Administration (China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial notice issuing a 2026–2030 action plan to promote new-energy inland waterway vessels (electric, methanol, hydrogen). It sets targets for 2028 and 2030 covering fleet size, charging and fuelling infrastructure, and zero-carbon waterway corridors. It does not address AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2028 new-energy inland vessel fleet doubles vs 2025; over 1000 electric and 100 methanol-powered ships
3000 km of zero-carbon waterway transport corridors by 2028
Promote electric vessels for routes under 300 km and under 3000 DWT
Promote methanol-powered vessels for long-distance, large-tonnage freight
Encourage hydrogen, biodiesel and green methanol exploration
